# 逐步读法：在更新之内的分类与“活跃且不侵蚀”的 living，与整段读法两个方向都有分歧 / The stepwise reading: classification within renewal and living as active and not undermining, differing from the whole-run reading in both directions

## 主张 Claim

在依存网上，一个事件（形成，步）在更新之内，当它活跃，且该步维持它所参与的每个条件上的每个依存。整段运行的更新使每个活跃步都在更新之内；断裂所参与条件上依存的步不在更新之内；一个形成可以在自己的每个活跃步都在更新之内而整段不更新。一个形成对某条件的关系在某步侵蚀，当它在该步汲取该条件，而该步之后，一个当时或此前被满足的依存不被满足；在断裂某个依存之步汲取（断裂）是侵蚀的一种，在更新之内的事件既不侵蚀也不断裂。以“活跃且不侵蚀”为 living、以各自步上共同参与某一条件为 related：被断裂者在断裂之步不在更新之内，但不侵蚀，所以被记入；损失之后继续的汲取不再断裂任何依存，却侵蚀，而同样的第一步之后若不再汲取，条件回到；从未被满足的依存不使任何事件侵蚀。整段读法与这一读法两个方向都有分歧：先在更新之内汲取、后来超出的形成，整段记为消耗，第一个事件逐步被记入；先超出一次、条件随后恢复的形成，整段不记为消耗，断裂之步的事件逐步不被记入；两种读法都记入被断裂者在断裂之步的事件。每个活的事件都参与的条件使整体连通，于是 G0 恰等于种子加 N_rel 加 N_std；在断裂之步汲取的事件不是活的，并与被断裂形成参与该条件的每个事件相关，在 N_rel 下珍视它的立场必珍视那些活的事件。关系层读法以（形成，条件，步）为主张，活的关系是活跃、参与且不侵蚀；一个事件的逐步读法恰是它所参与关系的读法的合取，同一事件可以有一个活的关系和一个侵蚀的关系。依存不变时整段与逐步读法的 related 相同。 / On a web of dependence, an event (formation, step) is within renewal when it is active and its step keeps every dependence on every condition it participates in. Whole-run renewal credits every active step; a step breaking a dependence on a condition the event participates in is not within renewal; a formation can be within renewal at each of its own active steps without renewing in the run. A formation's relation to a condition undermines at a step when it draws on the condition at that step and, after the step, a dependence on it met then or before is unmet; drawing at a step that breaks a dependence (breaking) is a case of undermining, and an event within renewal neither undermines nor breaks. Taking “active and not undermining” as `living` and participation in a common condition at the events' steps as `related`: the broken formation is not within renewal at the breaking step but does not undermine, so it is credited; drawing after a loss breaks nothing further yet undermines, while with the same first step and no further drawing the condition returns; a requirement never met makes no event undermine. The whole-run reading and this one differ in both directions: a formation drawing within renewal at first and beyond it later is consuming on the whole-run reading while its first event is credited stepwise; a formation that draws beyond renewal once while the condition later returns is not consuming on the whole-run reading while its event at the breaking step is not credited stepwise; both credit the broken formation's event at the breaking step. A condition in which every living event participates makes the whole connected, so G0 is exactly a seed with N_rel and N_std; an event drawing at a breaking step is not living and is related to every event of the broken formation participating in that condition, so under N_rel a standpoint valuing it holds those living events significant. A relation-level reading takes (formation, condition, step) as claims, a living relation being active, participating and not undermining; an event's stepwise reading is exactly the conjunction over the relations it takes part in, and one event can have a living and an undermining relation. With constant dependence the whole-run and stepwise readings have the same `related`.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 依存网的可观测量如 becoming-dependence-dynamics 所设；draws 不带数量。 / The observables of the web are those of becoming-dependence-dynamics; draws carries no amount.
- living 取“活跃且不侵蚀”（或关系层的对应），related 取各自步上共同参与某一条件；两者都是公开的读法选择，不是被证明的对应。 / `living` is “active and not undermining” (or its relation-level counterpart) and `related` is participation in a common condition at the events' steps; both are disclosed reading choices, not proved correspondences.
- 连通的结论需要一个所有活的事件都参与的共同条件，并依赖条件与参与的对应纪律；传递结论需要 N_rel，其规范地位不由本结果证明。 / The connection result needs a condition in which every living event participates and depends on a correspondence discipline for conditions and participation; the transmission result needs N_rel, whose normative standing this result does not prove.

逐步读法读的是事件所处的关系，不是它的因果贡献。整段读法问形成在整段运行中是否消耗；逐步的更新分类问事件之步是否维持其条件；逐步的 living 问事件是否在曾被满足的依存随后不被满足的那一步汲取。逐步 living 先后有三个候选（在更新之内、不断裂、不侵蚀），每个都保留在核心中，连同使它不被采用的见证（整合文档 §7）。以哪一种或哪种组合作为生生的读法，是 Ren 方向内的选择，本结果不替 Ren 作出（整合文档 §8.5）。 / The stepwise reading reads the relations an event stands in, not its causal contribution. The whole-run reading asks whether a formation consumes over the run; the stepwise classification asks whether an event's step keeps its conditions; stepwise living asks whether an event draws at a step after which a dependence once met is unmet. Stepwise living had three candidates in turn (within renewal, not breaking, not undermining), each kept on the core with the witness that sets it aside (integration note §7). Which reading, or combination, is the reading of 生生 is a choice within Ren's direction that this result does not make on Ren's behalf (integration note §8.5).
